description.value: Exhale (operating as 'Exhale Art & Crystal') is an art gallery and crystal shop located in the Okanagan & Thompson region of British Columbia. It sits at the intersection of fine art and mineral/crystal retail, likely appealing to cyclists looking for a cultural or curiosity stop on a touring route. The minimal web presence makes it something of a hidden gem worth discovering in person.
